headlines.title: Hochul and James vow to investigate Cornell sexual assault case
headlines.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said during a press conference she believes the former Cornell University student who alleges she was raped by fraternity members in 2024 was “failed by people and institutions with an obligation to protect her.” Hochul confirmed that she has appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor in the investigation.

headlines.title: Cornell survey showed increase in reports by female undergrads of nonconsensual sexual contact
headlines.description: The findings are drawing renewed attention after the local district attorney said he was reopening a criminal investigation into allegations of a 2024 gang rape at the university.

headlines.title: G7 countries to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil reserves
headlines.description: Group of Seven countries agreed to release tens of millions of barrels of diesel fuel and crude to cap soaring gas prices.

headlines.title: Tennessee Inmate in Critical Condition Following Failed Execution
headlines.description: Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee has issued a moratorium on executions for the rest of the year as investigators try to figure out what went wrong after convicted murderer Christa Pike survived two doses of lethal injection. Pike’s attorneys say she’s alive and in critical condition but her prognosis remains unclear. NBC’s Jesse Kirsch reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Vance talks 2028, Ted Cruz and a tough midterm climate that could affect his future
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance said the GOP faces an “uphill climb” in the midterms — and that the results may be a data point he reviews as he decides his 2028 plans.

headlines.title: Democrats regain ground on voter registration in key states after steep post-2024 drops
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk analysis of voter file data in seven states found that Democrats managed to reverse or slow their registration decline over the past year.

headlines.title: How 16 undecided voters are weighing their 2026 election options
headlines.description: The voters, who participated in a recent NBC News poll and spoke to reporters afterward, are laser-focused on high prices and largely disappointed with both parties.

headlines.title: Pilot Stabbed in Flydubai Attack Shares His Story for the First Time
headlines.description: The pilot that was stabbed during the suspected terror attack on a Flydubai plane is speaking out for the first time about his desperate decision to fight back and open the cockpit door that saved lives, getting emotional as he reflected on the near-disaster. “I feel proud of myself…I didn’t feel it until now, but now I do,” he says. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Supreme Court to decide multiple high-profile cases in new term
headlines.description: The Supreme Court is set to begin its new term with a number of high-profile cases involving President Trump on the docket. NBC News’ Lawrence Hurley explains which cases to look for.

headlines.title: When teens get colorectal cancer, it’s often an aggressive form of the disease
headlines.description: Only a tiny number of colorectal cancer cases occur in people younger than 21, but they’re often diagnosed at later stages and more difficult to treat.

headlines.title: Mike Tomlin Reveals His ‘Minecraft’ City With Full Tour
headlines.description: After Mike Tomlin’s reveal of his “Minecraft” hobby on Craig Melvin’s “Glass Half Full” podcast went viral, the legendary NFL coach released a nearly 20-minute long video diving into his city planning.
